correctness.rationale: A fresh independent finite construction used all 15 nonzero vectors of F2^4 as points and 15 maximal isotropic triples as lines under the symplectic form, giving 30 degree-three graph vertices, 45 edges, and bipartite distances d=1 or 3 for 450 opposite-side ordered endpoint pairs. Independently enumerating ALL length-five localized chains of degrees k=2,3,4 and computing F2 boundary-column ranks gave d=1 profile (C2,C3,C4,r3,r4,β)=(8,36,56,8,28,0), 90 blocks; d=3 profile (14,45,40,14,27,4), 360 blocks. The chain condition was checked in the inspected verifier; independent rank totals (5760,19440,19440,5760,12240,1440) agree exactly. Bipartite parity excludes same-side length-five chains. This is an exhaustive finite proof for the stated graph and bidegree, not a general infinite theorem. The 90 eight-cycle and four-containing-geodesic counts were checked in source certificate; geodesic uniqueness follows from girth≥8.
residual_risks: Independent GF2 rank and eight-cycle enumerations cover the specified finite graph exhaustively, but do not prove analogous assertions for arbitrary girth-eight graphs.
Only F2 coefficients, bidegree (3,5), and this particular 30-vertex graph are established.
